{
  "decision-choose-same-day-reimbursement-batch": "WITH ready AS (
  SELECT voucher_id, principal_cents, principal_cents + fee_cents AS cost
  FROM voucher
  WHERE stage = 'ready'
), batches AS (
  SELECT voucher_id AS first_id, NULL AS second_id, principal_cents, cost AS cash_used_cents, 1 AS voucher_count
  FROM ready
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.voucher_id, b.voucher_id, a.principal_cents + b.principal_cents, a.cost + b.cost, 2
  FROM ready AS a
  JOIN ready AS b ON a.voucher_id COLLATE BINARY < b.voucher_id
)
SELECT first_id, second_id, principal_cents, cash_used_cents
FROM batches
WHERE cash_used_cents <= (SELECT cash_cents FROM run_limit)
ORDER BY voucher_count DESC, principal_cents DESC, first_id COLLATE BINARY, second_id COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-choose-two-recovery-retrofits": "WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT kit_code, lift_bay, fit_hours, proposed_grams - existing_grams AS gain
  FROM retrofit_trials
  WHERE existing_grams IS NOT NULL AND proposed_grams IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT a.kit_code AS first_code, b.kit_code AS second_code,
       a.gain + b.gain AS gained_grams, a.fit_hours + b.fit_hours AS install_hours
FROM eligible AS a
JOIN eligible AS b ON a.kit_code COLLATE BINARY < b.kit_code AND a.lift_bay <> b.lift_bay
WHERE a.fit_hours + b.fit_hours <= 8
ORDER BY gained_grams DESC, install_hours ASC, first_code COLLATE BINARY, second_code COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-citation-footnote-duplicate-lineages": "WITH RECURSIVE reached(note_id, ancestor) AS (
  SELECT note_id COLLATE BINARY, note_id COLLATE BINARY FROM review_notes
  UNION
  SELECT r.note_id, c.source_note
  FROM reached AS r
  JOIN footnote_citations AS c ON c.child_note COLLATE BINARY = r.ancestor
), originals AS (
  SELECT r.note_id, r.ancestor
  FROM reached AS r
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM footnote_citations AS c WHERE c.child_note COLLATE BINARY = r.ancestor)
), sizes AS (
  SELECT note_id, COUNT(*) AS original_count FROM originals GROUP BY note_id
)
SELECT a.note_id AS note_a, b.note_id AS note_b, a.original_count
FROM sizes AS a
JOIN sizes AS b ON a.note_id COLLATE BINARY < b.note_id AND a.original_count = b.original_count
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT ancestor FROM originals WHERE note_id = a.note_id
  EXCEPT
  SELECT ancestor FROM originals WHERE note_id = b.note_id
)
ORDER BY note_a COLLATE BINARY, note_b COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-cite-active-glaze-inspection-card": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT f.firing_code, c.allowance, c.card_id,
         CASE c.primary_text
           WHEN 'Count extra pinholes on the trial tile.' THEN f.trial_pits - f.control_pits
           WHEN 'Count any difference between the tiles.' THEN ABS(f.trial_pits - f.control_pits)
         END AS assessed_difference,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.firing_code ORDER BY c.start_day DESC, c.card_id COLLATE BINARY DESC) AS card_rank
  FROM tile_firings AS f
  JOIN inspection_cards AS c ON c.finish_code = f.finish_code AND c.start_day <= f.firing_day
  WHERE f.control_pits IS NOT NULL AND f.trial_pits IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT firing_code, assessed_difference, allowance, card_id
FROM ranked
WHERE card_rank = 1 AND assessed_difference > allowance
ORDER BY firing_code COLLATE BINARY"
}
